question: Does exact half-trace table construction by normalized Artin-Schreier inversion reduce complete cold ECC2K-130 index-calculus query instructions, with all cache construction charged?

claims.text: Every basis/table value, query decision, original witness/model/group/common/projected diagnostic agrees with the original scalar-chain construction.
Both fixed uniform controls use at least5% fewer complete cold instructions; every A/A discrepancy<=1%, and no cold/oracle cell regresses more than1%.

arms.description: Same release harness with exact frozen scalar-chain f2m source
Same release harness with current production f2m source with exact elimination constructor
Same release harness with exact frozen scalar-chain f2m source

positive.not_applicable_reason: Positive planted/cancellation known answers embedded in every arm; extra planted-1 largest-class pilot must Found/replay.

negative.not_applicable_reason: Both uniform fixed cases have separate polynomial-arithmetic negative proofs; embedded across every arm. No null-population/structural claim.

factors.name: instrument
factors.value: Two pinned executables, same harness/compiler/non-field source; one field-table algorithm factor.
factors.how: legacy-halftrace selects the exact old f2m source snapshot; default selects current production f2m with the elimination constructor. All other source, flags, hardware and query boundaries fixed. Separate processes prevent a shared global table cache from applying one builder to both arms. Compiler/layout effects are included in integrated counts; no isolated-function timing claim.

factors.name: instances
factors.how: Six disclosed prior d12 cases. Identical compact single-query payload on every arm; eight hashes include the two additional positive pilot targets. No old all-workload parser result is used as a new arm.

factors.name: order
factors.how: Rotate three arms by field/kind/repetition; five rounds.

factors.name: threads
factors.how: Single-threaded native solver; one CPU allocation and2GiB process address-space ceiling for the proposed local exception.

factors.name: host
factors.how: Current Intel Xeon Platinum8573C x86 host; CPU0,2GiB; Callgrind instructions only. No old-host absolute ratio.

factors.name: cache_and_layout
factors.how: Fresh native/profile children per call. Each pays full field-cache construction, parsing, relation work and replay. Lazy symbolic context fixed.

factors.name: preemption
factors.how: Outer600second total guard, no retries; raw process output and flushed JSONL prefixes retained.

factors.name: analyst
factors.how: Deterministic frozen Rust summary and separate Rust grid audit; no adaptive cases or population inference.

seed_derivation.note: Reuse exact fixed prior65-case workload; primary selection explicitly n83/131,d12,distinct-planted-0/uniform/cancellation.

instance_sampling.rule: Reuse exact fixed prior65-case workload; primary selection explicitly n83/131,d12,distinct-planted-0/uniform/cancellation.

blinding.how: Descriptive finite panel only; deterministic Rust summary and decision rules frozen before affected data, arm labels retained for reproducibility. No adaptive interpretation or population test.

power.note: Descriptive fixed six-cell A/B/A, five exact repeat ranges; no population p-value or CI.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: Planning placeholder; replaced with measured largest-class engineering pilot before primary freeze.

primary.name: Whole cold-process Ir
primary.definition: Sum calibrated setup/oracle/post counter dumps from one complete fresh process, all setup and verification charged.

secondary.name: Complete relation-oracle Ir
secondary.definition: Client-request partition from before solver call through returned report. Includes base admission, all projection/precompute/search, roots/lifts and internal replay; given context/input construction is separate setup, not silently free.

secondary.name: Setup Ir
secondary.definition: Parsing the same compact Case input, curve/variety construction, eager/lazy symbolic preparation and input point decoding.

secondary.name: Post Ir
secondary.definition: Wrapper replay, serialization, destruction and process exit.

secondary.name: Field multiplies
secondary.definition: Informational compact-workspace ledger only; excludes general F2m table construction. It cannot price the constructor change; complete Ir is primary.

secondary.name: Field squares
secondary.definition: Informational compact-workspace ledger only; excludes general F2m table construction. It cannot price the constructor change; complete Ir is primary.

stopping_rules.rule: Fixed6cases x3arms x5repetitions=90 primary rows. Separate12-call largest-class pilot and phased/unphased calibration for BOTH baseline and candidate.
Stop on any invalid Found/Refuted result, preserving all rows.
Combined final calibration/pilot/freeze/primary600seconds at CPU0/2GiB, zero retries and paid resources; preserve any failed prefix.

decision_rule.text: On BOTH fixed uniform controls elimination/baseline complete cold Ir<=0.95. Every case has exact matching answers/diagnostics, A/A cold discrepancy<=1%, cold ratio<=1.01 and oracle ratio<=1.01. Otherwise report the actual partial/null/regression outcome without changing thresholds.
decision_rule.statistic: Per-cell five-repeat min/median/max; exact paired median ratios, six A/A discrepancies and explicit no-regression checks
decision_rule.interval: Exact repeat ranges only; exposed anchors, no population CI
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: Ratio of identical-boundary complete cold-process or complete relation-oracle simulated instructions

inadmissible: No timing, scaling, population, full-DLP or challenge-recovery claim.
UNKNOWN is not UNSAT; no row deletion, adaptive seeds or comparison of unpaired favorable subsets.
Native group counters exclude field/ANF, non-group inversions and SAT work; they are not a complete cost unit.

literature.claim: Lemma5: AS is F2-linear with image ker(trace). Odd-degree normalization and exact H root follow from existing half-trace identities; no novelty claim.
Trace mask already uses Newton identities; existing half-trace initialization uses a separate scalar chain per basis image. Replace only that constructor.

extensions.runtime_planning: Max pilot combined child cost per field/arm over positive/uniform, times15 primary calls; fixed includes final calibration/pilot/freeze.
extensions.phase_calibration: Baseline AND elimination phased/unphased whole totals agree within0.1%.
extensions.nonpanel_reason: n83 uses E0, the same matched algebraic fixture as prior studies; standard K1-83 is E1 and full TraceZeroVariety here is E0 only. ECC2K-130 is standard K0-131.
extensions.cost_chain: Whole cold=setup+oracle+post, with every fresh global field table built and charged in setup. Same solver/model/order and replay.
extensions.qualification: Actual numeric modules; the sole baseline variant is the exact original f2m snapshot, selected by study-only compile feature. Both share original qualified unexecuted SAT/chain support. Root test result is separate.
extensions.previous_result: Merged adjoint projector at main d86b95d56a is baseline, not the previous pre-adjoint solver. Ratios do not compound across panels.
extensions.scope: Enable only exact complete83/131 polynomials; retain every other field and singular-input scalar-chain fallback. All lookup entries and H(1) root normalization must agree.
